A=(0,0), C=(2,0), B=(1,\sqrt3).

\[
\overrightarrow{AB}=(1,\sqrt3),\quad \overrightarrow{BD}=\frac13\overrightarrow{BC}=\frac13(1,-\sqrt3)
\]

\[
\overrightarrow{AD}=\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{BD}
=\left(1+\frac13,\sqrt3-\frac{\sqrt3}{3}\right)
=\left(\frac43,\frac{2\sqrt3}{3}\right)
\]

\[
\overrightarrow{CA}=A-C=(-2,0),\quad
\overrightarrow{CE}=\frac12\overrightarrow{CA}=(-1,0)
\]

So \(E=(1,0)\), hence

\[
\overrightarrow{BE}=E-B=(0,-\sqrt3)
\]

Thus,

\[
\overrightarrow{AD}\cdot \overrightarrow{BE}
=\left(\frac43,\frac{2\sqrt3}{3}\right)\cdot(0,-\sqrt3)
=-\frac{2\sqrt3}{3}\cdot \sqrt3=-2
\]

\[
\boxed{-2}
\]
